correctness.rationale: Cut the timetable at a certain departure and rotate labels to p_1=1. This yields the exact cycle partition even if availability is resampled in subsequent periods: no forward wait crosses the next certain departure. For normalized gaps, uniform-time integration of the residual wait over each realized active interval gives W/T=gᵀHg/2, with H_ij the probability the two gaps belong to the same interval. For i<j this is H_ij=∏_{k=i+1}^j q_k, q_k=1−p_k, since precisely the intervening services must cancel. The all-operate event gives H≥(∏p_k)I in quadratic form. Independently, with D unit lower bidiagonal and D_(i,i−1)=−q_i, the product formula gives DHDᵀ=diag(1,1−q_2²,…,1−q_n²). Its inverse factorization gives s_i=(H^−1 1)_i=1/(1+q_i)−q_(i+1)/(1+q_(i+1))=(v_i+v_(i+1))/2, where q_1=q_(n+1)=0. Thus 1ᵀs=S, s/S is interior, and H(s/S)=1/S. Positive definiteness proves uniqueness and the minimum. Subtracting the optimum cancels the linear term on the fixed-sum hyperplane; expanding zᵀHz by realized blocks proves the exact regret and all-operate certificate. The displayed coefficient is a valid bound (and equality is possible for instances in the class), not necessarily the best coefficient for each fixed reliability vector. The symmetric S proves order invariance. For the example, masks with no optional cancellations, one cancellation, and two adjacent cancellations have total probabilities 1/10, 1/2, 2/5 and equal-spacing conditional costs T/8, 3T/16, 5T/16. This reproduces 37T/160 and, from S=22/9, 9T/44 and the relative reduction 47/407. The finite checker and verification notes were inspected without running the supplied script. The proof uses the specified p_i>0, independence and at least one certain service; no extension to a fully unreliable cycle or correlated cancellations is inferred.

evidence: Dette et al. give the best linear unbiased estimator and variance for arbitrary positive definite covariance, and explicit optimal weights for triangular kernels at finitely many ordered points (Corollary 2.1). Their inverse formulas include all finite irregular exponential covariances.

Baran et al., arXiv:1704.05719 p. 6, state for the real OU case the exact constant-trend information 1+Σ(1−exp(−λd_i))/(1+exp(−λd_i)), and attribute it to earlier OU design work. Their Appendix A.1 also gives a block tridiagonal inverse generalizing real OU.
The Parmigiani abstract instead minimizes inspection and undetected-failure costs for its stated model.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The relevant broad source is an explicit weight-and-value result, not merely the existence of a method to optimize a covariance quadratic. It reaches this entire frozen family by the exponential substitution and the block/continuity argument. No similar implication is inferred from the fallible-inspection abstract.

evidence: For the triangular kernel e^{−|t_i−t_j|} and trend f≡1, the prior formulas give unnormalized weights s=H^−1 1 with interior entries 1/(1+q_i)−q_(i+1)/(1+q_(i+1)) and the same rule at endpoints using zero exterior correlations. These are (v_i+v_(i+1))/2 where v_i=(1−q_i)/(1+q_i).

The prior best variance is 1/(1ᵀH^−1 1)=1/S, also given by the OU information formula since the exterior anchor contributes one. Multiplying by T/2 gives the asserted minimum. Its dependence on the reliabilities is a symmetric sum.

For the optimal weight g*, H g*=1/S times the all-ones vector; hence for any ∑g_i=1 the variance excess is (g−g*)ᵀH(g−g*). The random block Gram representation already needed to identify H rewrites this as the submitted regret sum, whose all-operate summand is the submitted lower estimate.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The core classification is a specialization of known explicit formulas, not a computation from generic positive definiteness with a substantial additional theorem. The wait interpretation, positivity, normalization, block limit, and the regret certificate are short direct deductions and do not leave a distinct mathematical result of the size claimed.

evidence: With q_i=1−p_i after the guaranteed cut, H_ij=∏_{k=i+1}^j q_k for i<j. With positive interior q_i, take t_1=0, t_i−t_(i−1)=−log q_i; then H_ij=e^{−|t_i−t_j|}, a triangular kernel with u(t)=e^t and v(t)=e^{−t}.

The constant-mean model Y_i=θ+ε_i with covariance H has unbiased linear estimators exactly when ∑g_i=1, and their variance is 2W/T. Although linear estimation allows signed weights, its optimum here is strictly positive.

If an additional q_i=0, H splits into independent exponential covariance blocks; equivalently it is the limit replacing every internal zero by ε>0. The limiting H is positive definite, so the inverse weights and variance are continuous. A singleton block contributes precision one.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: This identifies the optimization objectives and constraint, not just a similarity in a sum or estimator. The endpoint q_1=q_(n+1)=0 is the artificial exterior of the observed line after the guaranteed cut; internal zeros are accounted for by blocks. The simplex constraint does not change the optimum.

exact_database_or_table.reasoning: A table of schedules at isolated reliability values would not decide a theorem for continuous reliabilities and every n≥4. originality.rationale: Demonstrable coverage by stronger existing optimal-weight and variance formulas, not an unresolved possibility of overlap. After cutting at the certain departure, the exact passenger waiting quadratic is half the variance of a constant-trend linear estimator with irregular exponential covariance, up to T. Dette–Pepelyshev–Zhigljavsky (2016), arXiv:1501.01774, Eq. (1.6), Lemma 2.1 and Corollary 2.1 (Eqs. (2.5)–(2.7)), give the optimal weights and variance for the larger class of triangular covariance kernels. The specialization below covers the claimed gaps, value, and permutation invariance; the regret is the accompanying quadratic identity, and the explicit bound is the immediate all-operate summand. No claim is made that the prior authors wrote a transit interpretation.
residual_risks: Earlier application-specific transit or inspection priority remains unadjudicated; the failure rests on demonstrated mathematical coverage, not on the inaccessible earlier articles.
The comparison does not establish a result for cycles without a certain anchor or correlated service; those are different research questions, not surviving claims of this record.

value.rationale: The objective and cancellation model are motivated, and the formulas can be useful as a transit interpretation. But after the guaranteed cut makes the objective an irregular exponential covariance quadratic, the exact minimizing weights, minimum and order invariance are mechanical consequences of existing stronger formulas. The exact excess follows from expansion about the prior optimizer, and its stated lower constant simply retains the all-operate event. No independently substantive new invariant or supported extension remains in this frozen theorem under the scientific-value criterion.
